summary: Tested per-site data isolation + Manager RBAC across Memberships, CRM and Marketing. Backend pytest HTTP e2e: 11 PASS + 1 XFAIL (real bug). Frontend Playwright verified Site Switcher behaviour. Owner switcher correctly lists All Sites + Demo Head Office + Demo Branch B (testids site-switcher-all, site-switcher-item-iso-demo-site-a, site-switcher-item-iso-demo-site-b). Manager switcher correctly hidden (only 1 allowed site, by component design). Backend /api/sites/leaderboard returns both rows for owner with HQ flagged + metrics. Two notable gaps below.

critical.issue: Org owner sees ONLY 1 company (their own BravoCo) instead of both. Root cause: routes/crm_auth.get_crm_user mirrors role+allowed_site_ids to the request scope (site_scope ContextVar) but does NOT mirror the primary user's `role` onto the returned `user` dict. Therefore crm_permissions.compute_visibility -> is_unrestricted(user) reads crm_users.role (='manager' on the iso-demo seed for both accounts) and degrades the org owner to team-only visibility. Result: owner@isodemo.com gets companies={BravoCo} only. Fix: in get_crm_user also do `user['role'] = scope_user['role']` (and ideally is_org_owner/is_master_admin too) before returning. Verified by curl: CRM /auth/login response for owner shows `user.role='manager'`.

integration_issues.issue: Owner picks 'All Sites' in switcher then navigates to /operations or /dashboard — the SiteLeaderboard component (data-testid=site-leaderboard / site-leaderboard-table / site-leaderboard-row-<id>) is NOT present in the rendered DOM. Backend GET /api/sites/leaderboard works perfectly (returns both rows, HQ flagged, all metric columns: active_members/mrr_gbp/open_deals/campaigns_30d/open_faults). So the wiring of SiteLeaderboard into the OverviewTab on the actual Operations dashboard URL is missing or gated. Main agent: confirm where OverviewTab.js is mounted and that allSitesMode triggers the SiteLeaderboard render.

integration_issues.flow: Account Settings → Team & roles site-access UI
integration_issues.issue: Navigating to /account (and /account/settings 404s) doesn't expose any data-testid containing 'team' / 'account-team'. Per-teammate site-access controls were not visible from this entry point. Main agent: verify the exact route + testid (e.g. data-testid='account-team' on team panel and on the per-row site-access PATCH controls).

Navigating to /memberships or /marketing from a logged-in session lands on the marketing-site 404 page ('PULSE FITNESS · 404 - We can't find that page') instead of the in-app module console. Backend data is correct (verified via API), but the UI rows could not be visually confirmed because the SPA route resolves to 404. May be a ModuleAccessGate fallthrough or the iso-demo-org needs modules enabled for the user (the seed sets modules at the org level, double-check the user-level access check). Reproduce: log in as owner@isodemo.com → navigate to https://<host>/memberships → 404.

issues: Restricted manager (1 allowed site) gets no switcher at all — by design (component hides for sites.length<2). The review request implied the manager should still see their 1 site + 'All Sites'. Either: (a) update SiteSwitcher to render when restricted regardless of count, OR (b) accept current behaviour and document. Currently the manager has no way to flip into 'All Sites' from the UI.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix routes/crm_auth.get_crm_user to mirror primary user's role onto the returned user dict (not just the ContextVar scope) so crm_permissions.is_unrestricted recognises the org owner. Without this, the CRM separate-auth path silently down-scopes owners to team visibility — this IS the kind of leak the review explicitly called out (just in the opposite direction: under-grant, not over-grant).
Wire SiteLeaderboard.js into the Operations dashboard so data-testid='site-leaderboard' renders for owner in All-Sites mode. Backend endpoint is ready.
Verify Account Settings → Team & roles route + testids; restricted user could not be located via [data-testid*='team'] at /account.
Investigate why /memberships and /marketing render the marketing-site 404 inside an authenticated SPA session — looks like a route or module-gate misconfiguration for the iso-demo-org.
UX decision: should the SiteSwitcher render for a restricted manager with only 1 allowed site so they still have an 'All Sites (my sites)' affordance? Currently it's hidden.
critical_code_review_comments: crm_auth.get_crm_user mirrors role into scope_user but assigns only allowed_site_ids back onto user; should also assign user['role'] = scope_user['role'] and user['is_org_owner'] = scope_user['is_org_owner'] so downstream is_unrestricted() / sharing-rule checks see the same identity. This is a security-relevant divergence.
utils/site_scope.py looks solid — single ContextVar source of truth, X-Site-Id header + ?site_id= both wired, 403 site_access_denied raised centrally in build_site_filter.
routes/sites.py GET /sites/leaderboard correctly narrows via build_site_filter and is well-structured; consider returning mrr in pence too (mrr_pence) alongside mrr_gbp for analytics consistency.
SiteSwitcher.js: `if (!sites || sites.length < 2) return null;` should probably also consider the restricted-with-1-site case (currently hidden, which the review request seemed to assume rendered).
Test data assertion: review_request says manager should see only 'AlphaMember' — verified via backend API. UI verification blocked by /memberships 404 issue above.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend isolation (Memberships, Marketing, /sites, CRM separate-token) all enforce site_access_denied correctly and narrow manager rows to Alpha/Site A. The one outstanding backend bug is the CRM-owner-role-leak in get_crm_user (described above) — the e2e test xfails on this so it's tracked. What's NOT verified visually: (a) site-leaderboard rendering on Operations dashboard, (b) members/campaigns list narrowing in the in-app pages (because /memberships and /marketing resolve to the marketing-site 404 in this session — likely a route guard or module-gate issue specific to this preview), (c) Account Settings Team site-access UI. After the main agent fixes the routing/leaderboard wiring, re-run the playwright flow and the http_e2e pytest.
rca of the issue: CRM owner-role-leak RCA — Reproduce: `curl -X POST $URL/api/crm/auth/login -d '{"email":"owner@isodemo.com","password":"IsoDemo123!"}'` returns user.role='manager'; using that token, GET /api/crm/v2/companies returns only BravoCo (the owner's own row). Expected: AlphaCo + BravoCo. Root cause: routes/crm_auth.py:84-95 — get_crm_user computes scope_user.role from the primary users record and stamps it into the ContextVar via set_request_site_scope(scope_user), but only writes back `user['allowed_site_ids']` on the returned user dict (line 93). compute_visibility in routes/crm_permissions.py then reads user['role'] from the crm_users collection record (where role='manager' for both seeded accounts) and is_unrestricted() returns False for the org owner. The user is then restricted to team visibility, which on this seed = owner_id == iso-owner = BravoCo only. Mitigation: in get_crm_user also set `user['role'] = scope_user['role']` (and `user['is_org_owner'] = scope_user['is_org_owner']`, `user['is_master_admin'] = scope_user['is_master_admin']`) before returning.
